elicitation_input.first_turn_response:
"Don't Rain on My Parade" is from the musical **Funny Girl**, which premiered on Broadway in 1964. The song was written by Jule Styne (music) and Bob Merrill (lyrics), and it was originally performed by Barbra Streisand, who played the lead role of Fanny Brice.

Streisand also performed the song in the 1968 film adaptation of Funny Girl, which further cemented its popularity as one of her signature songs.
